summary: but like I said, I avoid the primaries. So undemocratic. I don't even know who will still be on the ticket by the chance it gets to Connecticut, and no matter the outcome of the primary my state will go blue, regardless of anything I do
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: but like I said, I avoid the primaries. So undemocratic. I don't even know who will still be on the ticket by the chance it gets to Connecticut, and no matter the outcome of the primary my state will go blue, regardless of anything I do
